connect_graphics_server: connect to a pybullet graphics server using GRAPHICS_SERVER_TCP mode
set_additional_search_path: set an additional search path for pybullet data assets using pybullet_data
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model like r2d2.urdf into the pybullet simulation at a given position
set_gravity: set the gravity vector for the pybullet physics simulation environment
step_simulation: step the pybullet simulation forward one timestep while connected to the server
